purpose: Repair the conventional F1 uncertainty family after V1 produced zero eligible candidates, without changing the persistence mean model, calibration thresholds, F0, or any agentic layer.

revision_trigger.mechanistic_diagnosis: V1 national uncertainty is rank-1: every national draw is parallel to the single realized national CLR vector in the training transition. This gives zero or near-zero support to unseen party-direction national shocks. Territorial marginal dispersion is also inherited without shrinkage, allowing training-transition low-variance party dimensions to remain implausibly narrow out of transition.

uncertainty_family.national: Full-support CLR-subspace shrinkage prior: combine the empirical rank-1 training national direction with isotropic zero-mean Gaussian noise projected onto the CLR subspace. The total national scale and isotropic fraction are selected only from the frozen grid.
uncertainty_family.territorial: Bootstrap training territorial residual rows, then shrink party-specific marginal variances toward their pooled variance before CLR recentering. The pooling fraction and total territorial scale are selected only from the frozen grid.

crossfit.fold_A: train uncertainty on 2016->2021 residual structure; evaluate persistence forecast on 2011->2016
crossfit.fold_B: train uncertainty on 2011->2016 residual structure; evaluate persistence forecast on 2016->2021

gates.coverage_gate: Every one of the 9 frozen party buckets must clear both floors in both crossfit folds.
gates.sharpness_gate: Selected mean 95% interval width must be strictly below F0 Uncertainty V2 width 0.5445930074002108.
gates.selection: Among candidates passing party coverage in both folds, minimize mean absolute calibration error, then mean energy score, then mean 95% interval width.
